risk_if_not_implemented: Without Remote Maintenance, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
compensating_control_1.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
(1) Remote network access; 
(2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
(3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process sensitive and/or regulated data.
compensating_control_1.justification: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) (IAC-37) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Remote Maintenance (MNT-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Non-Console Administrative Access
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of non-console administrative access.
compensating_control_2.justification: Non-Console Administrative Access (CFG-04.7) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Remote Maintenance (MNT-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms.
